correctness.rationale: Stationary OU covariance Dr exp(−|t|/τ)/τ integrates exactly to Var(θ_t−θ_0−Ωt)=2Dr[t−τ(1−e^(−t/τ))]; Green–Kubo gives K(τ,Ω)=∫ Cτ(t) cos Ωt dt. At τ↓0 the first derivative is positive Dr²/(Dr²+Ω²). For fixed Ω≠0, Cτ′ has a single negative extremum and two integrations by parts give |K|≤2 max|Cτ′|/Ω²→0 as τ→∞; continuity ensures a finite interior global maximum. At Ω=0, Cτ increases strictly and its Gaussian-scale integral ~√(πτ/(2Dr)). Under τ=Dr x/Ω², dominated Gaussian rescaling gives |Ω|K→F(x)=√(πx/2)e^(−x/2); small-x integral and large-x integration-by-parts bounds exclude escaping maximizers, so x→1 and F(1)=√(π/(2e)). Independently checked F′ and the OU variance identity algebraically; limited numerical tests do not certify universal limit.
residual_risks: Independent proof scrutiny depends on uniform large-x/small-x estimates as stated; finite peak searches alone do not establish global maximizing quantifiers.
